step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home button () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work > Clauses. The list of clauses inserted in the document is displayed.
Click on a clause name in the list. The document scrolls to highlight the selected clause in the template.

postreq.p: A newly marked clause is also displayed in the Clauses list
